inputs.message: Visible business object has no custom business metadata fields.
inputs.recommendation: Review whether this object requires business metadata, ownership, classification, retention or process tracking columns.

inputs.message: Visible business object has versioning disabled.
inputs.recommendation: Enable versioning for auditability, document history and recovery.

inputs.message: Versioning is enabled but no major version limit is set, so versions accumulate without bound.
inputs.recommendation: Set MajorVersionLimit to a retention-appropriate number of versions.

inputs.message: Custom metadata exists but content types are not enabled.
inputs.recommendation: Enable content types to standardise metadata and document classification.

inputs.message: Permission inheritance is broken on this object; it carries its own access control list.
inputs.recommendation: Confirm the unique permissions are intentional, documented and correctly scoped, and record the owner.

inputs.message: Item-level read or write security is set to a non-default restriction.
inputs.recommendation: Confirm the item-level restriction is intentional and documented.

inputs.message: Visible business object is excluded from search indexing.
inputs.recommendation: Confirm the search exclusion is intentional; otherwise re-enable crawling so content is discoverable.

inputs.message: Object is backed by an external data source.
inputs.recommendation: Record the upstream system, its owner and the refresh/authentication model.

inputs.message: Object holds more than 5000 items and is above the SharePoint list view threshold.
inputs.recommendation: Add indexed columns, filtered views or a folder/archive strategy to keep views performant.

inputs.message: Visible business object has no default retention or compliance label applied.
inputs.recommendation: Apply a retention label appropriate to the records held, or record why none is required.

inputs.message: Content approval is enabled but versioning is disabled, so approved and draft states cannot be reconstructed.
inputs.recommendation: Enable versioning wherever content approval is in use.

inputs.message: Visible business object has no description.
inputs.recommendation: Add a short description stating the object's business purpose and owner.

inputs.message: One or more detail calls for this object did not succeed, so its captured detail is incomplete.
inputs.recommendation: Re-run the capture for this object. Do not treat its field, content type or view counts as authoritative.

inputs.message: Root folder detail could not be retrieved, so storage metrics and retention label are unknown for this object.
inputs.recommendation: Re-run the capture, or confirm the connection identity can read the object's root folder.

inputs.message: Object inherits permissions from its parent web, so no object-level role assignments were requested. Web-level assignments in the web capture record are authoritative for this object.
Object has unique permissions but the role assignment call did not succeed, so its access control list is unknown.

inputs.purpose: Reviewer-facing register of every SharePoint list and library captured in this run, with governance settings, quality findings and the sign-off columns held in the companion SharePoint list.

howToUse: Start with objects whose businessRelevance is High, then Medium.
Confirm owner, business purpose, metadata adequacy, versioning, content types, retention and security for each.
Every object with hasUniqueRoleAssignments true needs an explicit decision on whether the broken inheritance is intentional.
Record decisions in the SharePoint list named in reviewRegisterListTitle. Decisions entered there are preserved across runs; this JSON file and the CSV are regenerated every run.

parameters.parameters/body: {"__metadata":{"type":"SP.List"},"BaseTemplate":100,"Title":"@{variables('varReviewRegisterListTitle')}","Description":"Persistent review register for the SharePoint metadata inventory. Capture columns are refreshed by the flow on every run; Reviewer, ReviewDecision, ReviewOwner, ActionRequired, DueDate and ReviewerNotes are owned by reviewers and are never overwritten.","EnableVersioning":true,"MajorVersionLimit":100}
